stories.headline: Elysian Aircraft raises €12 million in private and public funding
stories.quote: **Elysian Aircraft**, the Dutch aerospace company developing aviation electrification technologies, [raised €12 million] in private and public funding from FideFlux, SecFund, and ROM InWest, as well as from individual investors and family offices.
stories.description: Aerospace company developing aviation electrification technologies

stories.headline: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility is looking at an IPO in about 18 months, per Bloomberg
stories.quote: **Mahindra Last Mile Mobility**, an electric three-wheeler business under Mahindra & Mahindra, is looking at an IPO in about 18 months,[ per Bloomberg] .
stories.description: Electric three-wheeler business under Mahindra & Mahindra

facts.text: IPO being looked at for about 18 months from now, per Bloomberg
facts.quote: is looking at an IPO in about 18 months,[ per Bloomberg]

stories.headline: Numa raises $45 million Series C led by Blue Cloud Ventures
stories.quote: **Numa**, a startup developing an AI operating system for dealerships, raised a [$45 million Series C round] led by New York-based Blue Cloud Ventures.
stories.description: Startup developing an AI operating system for dealerships

stories.headline: Stark Future raises at least €150 million in equity led by Highland Europe, Reuters reported
stories.quote: **Stark Future**, a European electric motorcycle company, raised [at least €150 million] in equity, Reuters reported. The raise was led by Highland Europe, alongside Morgan Stanley Investment Management's 1GT and Axon Partners Group.

stories.headline: Vincue raises $93 million in round led by Wavecrest Growth Partners
stories.quote: **Vincue**, an automotive tech company that sells software to dealerships, [raised $93 million] in a round led by Wavecrest Growth Partners, with continued backing from FM Capital.
stories.description: Automotive tech company that sells software to dealerships

stories.headline: General Motors working with executive search firm on possible successors to CEO Mary Barra
stories.quote: You might have seen the Wall Street Journal [scoop] that **General Motors** is working with an executive search firm to identify possible candidates to replace CEO **Mary Barra**.

facts.text: GM has hired Heidrick & Struggles, per one source; board running a two-track search
facts.quote: GM has hired executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles, according to one source, who noted it’s possible that the board has other executive search firms working on this as well.

facts.text: Names floated include José Muñoz, Doug Field and Larry Culp
facts.quote: One name that has come up from the executive search firm is José Muñoz, who is president and CEO of Hyundai.

facts.text: Internal candidates include Sterling Anderson and Paul Jacobson
facts.quote: There are internal GM folks who are also in the mix, including Sterling Anderson, co-founder of self-driving trucks company Aurora who became [chief product officer] at GM in May 2025, and Paul Jacobson
And, for the record, GM declined to comment.

stories.headline: Waymo pulls its robotaxis off freeways again
stories.quote: Waymo pulling its [robotaxis off freeways] (again) and Zoox robotaxis [launching on the Uber app ] illustrate the push and pull between progress and setbacks in the autonomous vehicle industry.

facts.quote: Tesla has now surpassed Waymo in Texas in the number of robotaxis registered with the state (Tesla has 1,507 and Waymo has 1,345).

stories.headline: Uber adds Zoox robotaxis to its ride-hailing app in Las Vegas
stories.quote: Uber, as mentioned above, just added Zoox to its ride-hailing app in Las Vegas.

facts.text: Uber plans a dedicated autonomous option in its app
facts.quote: The company plans to introduce a dedicated autonomous option in its app as “availability and reliability improve,” Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said during the company’s third-quarter earnings call in November.

facts.text: Las Vegas to be first US city with two driverless partners on Uber
facts.quote: Las Vegas will also become the first U.S. city where riders can access two fully driverless partners through the Uber app, he said.

stories.headline: Tesla to spend about $3.3 billion expanding Berlin gigafactory to produce Cybercabs
stories.quote: **Tesla **said it will [spend about $3.3 billion] to expand its Berlin gigafactory to produce Cybercabs — yet another signal of the company’s global autonomy ambitions.

stories.headline: Tesla invites select customers to preorder Cybercab for personal use at $29,990
stories.quote: Over the weekend, Tesla invited “select customers” to [preorder the company’s autonomous, golden Cybercab] “for personal use.” The Cybercab is priced at $29,990, but there is a lot more to ownership.

facts.text: Owners charged $299 a month; delivery and operations geographically limited
facts.quote: The company will charge owners $299 a month to use the vehicles, delivery will only occur in a handful of cities, and operations will be limited to specific locations.

stories.headline: Uber notifying close to 150,000 drivers of personal data stolen in October breach
stories.quote: Meanwhile, Uber said it’s notifying [close to 150,000 drivers] that their personal information was stolen in an October data breach.

stories.headline: Also pauses deliveries of its new e-bike over software and battery problems
stories.quote: **Also**, the electric micromobility startup that spun out of Rivian last year, has paused deliveries of its new e-bike over problems with its software and batteries, [The Verge reported] .
stories.description: Electric micromobility startup that spun out of Rivian

stories.headline: Zipline and Uber officially launch drone delivery for Uber Eats in a Houston suburb
stories.quote: The companies had previously announced a partnership for drones to deliver for Uber Eats, but it [officially launched this week ] in a Houston suburb.

facts.text: Target of 1 million drone deliveries a day by end of 2029
facts.quote: Uber and Zipline say they aim to make 1 million deliveries a day using the startup’s drones by the end of 2029.
